value: Obsidian is a knowledge management application designed to empower users with privacy, customization, and long-term data ownership. It securely stores notes locally on your device, ensuring quick offline access and complete confidentiality from third parties. The platform offers unparalleled flexibility through thousands of plugins and themes, allowing users to tailor it to their unique thinking processes. Crucially, Obsidian utilizes open file formats, guaranteeing users are never locked in and retain full control over their knowledge for the long term.
